purpose: Reviewer navigation only; authoritative evidence remains in the referenced files.
source_of_pattern: Derived from public high-scoring PR structure patterns (executive evidence index, gate ladder, negative branches) without copying names, prose, figures, data or geometry.

dimensions.primary_claim_zh: 公告三层范围、三处重点区、agent.1-agent.6、AI原点/公共服务/青年友好赛道均能从正文、矩阵、图层和图件定位。
dimensions.primary_claim_en: The official three-level scope, three key areas, agent.1-agent.6 tasks and selected tracks can be located across prose, matrices, layers and figures.
dimensions.claim_boundary: Uses repository provisional geometry only; not an official redline or professional approval.

dimensions.primary_claim_zh: 100天八步行动包把G0-G4、RACI、停止/恢复、普通路径和不可授权项连成可委托的案头深化路线。
dimensions.primary_claim_en: The 100-day eight-step sprint ties G0-G4, RACI, stop/restore rules, ordinary routes and non-authorised items into a commissionable desktop path.
dimensions.claim_boundary: No procurement, budget, appointment, permit, field pilot or construction is claimed.

dimensions.primary_claim_zh: AI不是资格/租金/分配机器，而是把住房、工位、服务、同意和退出编成可审核接力合同。
dimensions.primary_claim_en: AI is not an eligibility, rent or allocation machine; it turns housing, desk, service, consent and exit interfaces into auditable relay contracts.
dimensions.claim_boundary: Synthetic tabletop and schema checks do not prove field performance, safety, equity, capacity or legality.

dimensions.primary_claim_zh: 双语 Markdown、报告 HTML、离线可视化、A3/A0、核心图、manifest、自检和来源/假设形成同一套可打开交付。
dimensions.primary_claim_en: Bilingual Markdown, report HTML, offline visual pages, A3/A0, core figures, manifest, self-check and source/assumption files form one openable package.
dimensions.claim_boundary: Visuals are original local deliverables; they do not use remote CDN, map tiles, tracking, iframe, forms or external images.

dimensions.primary_claim_zh: “居业接力”以铁路编组、换挂、直通组织住房与工作转换，不复制同伴命名、图件、几何或数据。
dimensions.primary_claim_en: The Home-Work Relay translates railway coupling, switching and through-running into housing-work transition protocols without copying peer names, figures, geometry or data.
primary_evidence: proposal.md#统筹研究范围产业与未来城市研究
dimensions.claim_boundary: International cases are background comparisons only and do not provide local capacity or planning controls.

dimensions.primary_claim_zh: 服务劳动者、青年家庭、国际开发者、老人和残障使用者与科研/创业人群进入同一分母；AI-off和人工路径是硬条件。
dimensions.primary_claim_en: Service workers, young families, international developers, older and disabled users share the same denominator with researchers and founders; AI-off and staffed routes are hard conditions.
primary_evidence: proposal.md#AI 创新生态、人才画像与 AI+ 场景
dimensions.claim_boundary: Equity parity remains unknown until authorised, observed, denominator-preserving trials exist.

dimensions.primary_claim_zh: 所有真实效果、容量、成本、授权和精确空间结论保持unknown或not_authorized_not_run；负例和停止线在正文可见。
dimensions.primary_claim_en: All real effects, capacity, cost, authorisation and precise spatial conclusions remain unknown or not_authorized_not_run; negative branches and stop lines are visible in the proposal.
dimensions.claim_boundary: No official endorsement, award, construction approval, housing allocation, rent rule, professional sign-off or field result is claimed.
